notes.title: Gladiator Breakdown : Secutor
notes.notes:
Steel yourself for the unstoppable might of Secutor, the embodiment of raw strength and indomitable spirit! Harkening back to the legendary gladiators of old, Secutor wields an imposing gladius and an impenetrable shield. 

With the discipline of a disciplined soldier, they charge into battle, their mighty blows echoing with the power of thunder. 

Legends whisper of Secutor's unyielding defence and their ability to stun foes with a thunderous shield bash!

[u][b]Abilities[/b][/u]
[b]
Sword Attack[/b]
A melee cut that deals 27 damage.

[b]Shield[/b]
Raise your shield and protect yourself from enemy attacks. Each blocked hit reduces your poise gauge and temporarily increases sword damage. 

[b]Jump Attack[/b]
Leap forward and strike deal 50 damage in AoE

[b]Stunning Run[/b]
Dash forward with your shield raised, dealing 30 damage and stunning any targets hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346213/a155e94090c411794fcec79da510857b2b841065.png[/img]

notes.title: Nibbler Breakdown : Giant
notes.notes:
The fearsome Giant Nibbler has a towering presence on the battlefield, often accompanied by its relentless kin in groups of three or more. With its massive size and brute strength, this colossal creature poses a formidable challenge to any gladiator daring enough to cross its path.

In battle, the Giant Nibbler is a relentless pursuer, its enormous form casting an ominous shadow over the arena. With every step, it shakes the ground, a chilling reminder of the power it wields. When it closes in on its prey, it unleashes powerful strikes with its sharp teeth and claws, making even the bravest warriors tremble.

However, for those who dare to stand their ground and face this towering behemoth, there are rewards beyond measure. Defeating the Giant Nibbler not only grants valuable loot but also the priceless satisfaction of overcoming an imposing adversary. It's a feat that separates the true champions from the rest, proving that even giants can fall in the face of unwavering determination and skill.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346213/54a3baa9bf689a423702f986e65b99b01aef8f4d.png[/img]

notes.title: Nibbler Showcase : Nibbler Boomers
notes.notes:
[b][u]NIBBLER BOOMERS[/u][/b]

These explosive little fiends add an extra layer of danger to the arena. 

The Nibbler Boomers will relentlessly chase players, ready to detonate upon contact or in a rain storm from the sky. 

Gladiators must keep their wits about them to avoid these explosive threats while staying focused on their primary targets. 

Timing and spatial awareness are crucial to surviving encounters with these volatile adversaries, and maybe pack an umbrella just to be safe. 

[u]Explosive Nibblers[/u]
Watch out Goblin these Explosive Nibblers will chase you around the arena and explode on impact!

[u]Boomer Rain[/u]
Best pack an umbrella Gobbo, these Explosive Nibblers are raining from the sky! 

[u]Giant Explosive Nibbler Invasion[/u]
Uh Oh! It's a HUGE NIBBLER INVASION they are coming in from every side!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346213/9c861436481deea4cfb5b085ffb48dfc220bf174.png[/img]

notes.title: Gladiator Breakdown: Dimachaerus
notes.notes:
Prepare to face the cunning prowess of Dimachaerus, the elusive assassin who dances in the shadows! 

Inspired by the tales of mythic tricksters, Dimachaerus emerges from the darkness with lightning-quick strikes. Armed with twin daggers, they strike fear into the hearts of their foes, launching surprise attacks and vanishing into thin air. Legends speak of their mastery of ambush, teleportation, and the art of deception!

[u][b]Abilities[/b][/u]

[b]DAGGER CUT[/b]
Dagger strike; this attack can be chained up to three times. On the third attack, it deals bonus damage.

[b]DAGGER THROW[/b]
Throws a fast dagger.

[b]EXPLOSIVE DAGGER THROW[/b]
Throw an explosive dagger that blows up on contact. Enemies touched and impacted by the explosion are stunned for 2 seconds.

[b]AMBUSH[/b]
Get into a riposte stance for 2 seconds. If hit, you teleport behind the attacker, stun them, and inflict heavy damage.

[b]INVISIBILITY[/b]
Become invisible and gain movement speed. When you inflict damage, become visible again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346213/f6fc7e30ac3f1ad5363db64cb5e931d07884cb04.png[/img]

notes.title: Gladiator Breakdown: Sagittarius
notes.notes:
Marvel at the archery prowess of Sagittarius, the celestial marksman guided by the arrows of fate! 

Inspired by the Roman archers who struck down their enemies from afar, Sagittarius unleashes a storm of arrows upon their foes. Their keen eyes and steady hand never miss their mark. Legends tell of their magical shots that slow down foes, stunning paralyzing arrows that render enemies defenceless, and a mighty shot that can send adversaries flying!

[u][b]Abilities[/b][/u]

[b]SIMPLE SHOT[/b]
Shoots an arrow that deals 25 damage.

[b]SLOWING ARROW[/b]
Fire an arrow that pierces through enemies and slows them down for 2s. It leaves behind a trail that slown enemies that enter its path.

[b]STUNNING ARROW[/b]
Fire a powerful arrow that damages and pushes enemies back, if an enemy is pushed back against a wall they are stunned for 2s.

[b]VOLLEY OF ARROWS[/b]
Fires 5 arrows in rapid succession, and each arrow deals 25 damage.

[b]DASH[/b]
Dash over a short distance, this ability has 3 charges and Sagittarius’ next attack deals 150% damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42346213/47c08c74cdad38f5b4e37975b5914691730acde9.png[/img]

notes.title: WANTED! - Shinny Nibbler
notes.notes:
Oi, oi, gather 'round, me fellow goblins! 

'Tis a tale of mischief and golden opportunity I'm tellin' ya! This weekend, from the stroke of midnight on Saturday till the final tick-tocks of Sunday, we embark on a daring quest: the Shiny Nibbler's Gold Heist! That sneaky critter 'as nicked our precious gladiator gold and stashed it deep within its wretched lair. But fret not, for this be our chance to snatch back what's rightfully ours!

With each Shiny Nibbler we topple, a grand reward awaits the brave goblins who dare face this challenge! Picture it, me warrior kin: the riches flowin' back into our hands as we serve justice to this slippery thief. Let our battle cries echo across the realm, our blades gleamin' with fierce determination as we give chase to this gold-gobblin' scoundrel!

No more shall the Shiny Nibbler taunt us with its ill-gotten loot. This be the moment, me dear goblins, to strike back, seize our wealth, and restore the balance of the realm. The chase be on, and mark me words, we won't rest until every last gladiator gold coin is snatched from its clutches!

So, sharpen yer weapons, rally yer goblin mates, and let the hunt commence! The Shiny Nibbler's Gold Heist begins at midnight on Saturday, right through till the final heartbeats of Sunday. Join the chase, reclaim what's rightfully ours, and let our Gladiator Gold shine brighter than a gorgon's scales!

Sharpen your blades, my fellow goblins, and ready your spirits for battle! The Shinny Nibbler won't be easy prey, but our goblin resilience knows no bounds. It's a race against the setting sun, a relentless pursuit of glory. As the night sky blankets the realm, may your blows be true, and may your gold pouches overflow with the spoils of victory!

notes.title: Join our playtest!
notes.notes:
Ready your bows, the next Goblin Gladiators playtest is coming, starting August 8th ! 

We're excited to share the game with you again, and all the new features, like tracked player progression.

Take your chance to get back in to the arena and send your enemies hobblin'! There are even rumours of the arenas creators joining the fray.

Since our game is still in development, we are working on some known issues such as:
[list]
[*] Sometimes when joining a PVP battle, it may not be possible to leave the queue by hitting escape. This can be avoided by starting a singleplayer mode (such as survival mode or the tutorial) before attempting to join a multiplayer match.
[*] When playing the Assassin character, using the counter ability on the Minotaur can cause the character to freeze in place. 
[*] Beggining sequence of Tutorial doesn't always trigger. This can be avoided by waiting until the tutorial tells you to move. If this bug affects you, please try restarting the game to try again.
[/list]
We are working hard to have these fixed as soon as possible!

Want to have your say? Come and talk to us on [url=https://discord.gg/cRFf5pG78a]discord![/url]

- The Goblin Gladiators Team
